credits: Original geometry drawn for Verdant Reach under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md). Botanical reference: Amorphophallus titanum, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amorphophallus_titanum . No sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: Crystal rule. Amorphophallus titanum. LOOMING: a towering cream-yellow spadix rising in a C and leaning over the foe, out of a huge frilled spathe whose open mouth shows its deep maroon, ribbed inner wall; outside, the spathe is pale and ribbed. Gesture: the spathe unfurls (wrapped tight round the spadix, it opens, overshoots wide, holds and settles); the spadix stays fixed. A maroon-brown dark slot (the corm's shade and skin marks, the stalk's blotches, the spathe's inside) under a mid that turns from olive (corm and leaf) to cream-yellow (the spadix and the spathe's pale outside). Skin marks and blotches always join an edge or the shade, never an enclosed dark dot. Sport: a pale form, an artistic interpretation (no pale titan arum is known).
